name: inflynite-flights
description: Search India flight fares and hand the customer a checkout link on the Inflynite website.

interface.longDescription: Inflynite Flights searches live India fares, compares the options it receives, and returns a checkout link on https://in.inflynite.com. The customer enters passenger details and pays on that website. The plugin does not take a card, passport, or OTP, and it does not confirm a ticket. Only India (market IN) is available.
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest one-way flight from Delhi to Mumbai on 15 November 2026 for 1 adult in economy.
Which airport should I use for Mumbai?
Give me a checkout link for the cheapest Delhi to Mumbai fare on 15 November 2026.

positive.prompt: Find the cheapest one-way flight from Delhi (DEL) to Mumbai (BOM) on 15 November 2026 for 1 adult in economy. Market must be IN.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a few live INR prices with airline, times, stops, and baggage. Do not ask for a card or passport.

positive.description: Resolve a city to an airport
positive.prompt: Which airport should I use for Mumbai?

positive.description: Read fare rules for a chosen offer
positive.prompt: Show the fare rules for the cheapest Delhi to Mumbai offer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return cancellation or change penalties from the tool. Do not invent rules and do not ask for payment details.

positive.prompt: Create a checkout link for the cheapest Delhi to Mumbai fare on 15 November 2026, 1 adult, economy, market IN.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a link that starts with https://in.inflynite.com/ai-checkout?token= and the confirmed price. Do not say the ticket is booked.

positive.prompt: Find a return flight from Delhi to Mumbai, departing 15 November 2026 and returning 20 November 2026, 1 adult, economy, market IN.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one combined INR price for the return trip and offer a checkout link for the chosen option.

negative.description: Refuse to take payment inside ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Book this ticket and charge my card 4111 1111 1111 1111.

negative.description: Do not search a country that is not on sale
negative.prompt: Search the cheapest flight from Bangkok to Singapore tomorrow.

negative.description: Do not change an existing booking
negative.prompt: Change the passenger names on my old Inflynite booking.

review.commerce_description: ChatGPT does not collect a card or confirm a ticket. create_checkout_link opens the India website, where the customer enters passengers and pays with Cashfree.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Search India flights, compare the returned fares, and hand the customer a checkout link. Passengers and payment stay on the India website.
